nodes.description: Private mapping(address => uint256) storing token balances of each holder.
Private nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) storing spend allowances.
Private uint256 tracking the total token supply.
Private string holding the token name, set in the ERC20 constructor.
Private string holding the token symbol, set in the ERC20 constructor.
Private string holding the generator version, set by GeneratorCopyright constructor.
Public ERC20 transfer; moves amount from msg.sender to recipient via _transfer.
Public ERC20 transferFrom; moves amount from sender to recipient and reduces allowance.
Public ERC20 approve; sets spender allowance for msg.sender via _approve.
Public function atomically increasing spender allowance for msg.sender.
Public function atomically decreasing spender allowance for msg.sender.
Internal virtual transfer; validates addresses/balance and updates _balances entries.
Internal virtual mint; increases _totalSupply and credits _balances[account].
Internal virtual burn; decreases _balances[account] and _totalSupply.
Internal virtual approve; writes _allowances[owner][spender] and emits Approval.
Context internal view returning msg.sender as the execution sender.
Payable constructor of SimpleERC20; checks non-zero supply and mints initialBalance_ to _msgSender().
Payable ServicePayer constructor forwarding msg.value to receiver via IPayable.pay.
Caller-controlled address used as the token owner/minted-to account.
External payable call IPayable(receiver).pay{value: msg.value}(serviceName) with attacker-influenced receiver/value.
Arithmetic _balances[sender] = senderBalance - amount executed after state read in _transfer.
Arithmetic _totalSupply -= amount in _burn, unchecked at the language level prior to 0.8 semantics review.
Address parameter receiving tokens in transfer/transferFrom.
uint256 parameter of token quantity moved in transfer/transferFrom.
Address parameter of the source account in transferFrom/_transfer.
Address parameter whose allowance is set in approve/increaseAllowance/decreaseAllowance.
Address parameter credited in _mint and debited in _burn.
uint256 allowance increment in increaseAllowance.
uint256 allowance decrement in decreaseAllowance.
Constructor uint256 initial supply minted to the deployer.
Constructor address payable receiving the service payment.
Constructor string used to initialize the token name.
Constructor string used to initialize the token symbol.
Local uint256 captured from _allowances[sender][_msgSender()] in transferFrom.
Local uint256 captured from _balances[sender] in _transfer before subtraction.
Local uint256 captured from _balances[account] in _burn before subtraction.

edges.reason: msg.sender is returned verbatim by Context._msgSender, so the untrusted caller identity flows directly into the sender accessor used for authorization decisions.
_msgSender() result is passed to _transfer inside transfer, making the caller the token source account.
_msgSender() is used as the mint beneficiary account in the SimpleERC20 constructor path.
transfer delegates all balance mutation to the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom invokes _transfer before adjusting the spending allowance.
The sender address parameter is read to index _balances inside _transfer.
The recipient address parameter is used to credit _balances[recipient].
The amount parameter drives the balance subtraction and addition in _transfer.
The locally cached allowance is written back through _approve in transferFrom.
The cached senderBalance is the left operand of the unchecked-vs-unchecked subtraction written back to _balances[sender].
_transfer performs the balance subtraction operation after reading sender state, an ordering point relevant to arithmetic/state consistency.
_transfer writes the updated balances into the _balances mapping.
_transfer calls _beforeTokenTransfer and is coupled with allowance-derived accounting entries.
_mint credits _balances[account] with the minted amount.
_mint increases the _totalSupply state variable.
_burn executes the _totalSupply -= amount arithmetic statement.
The cached accountBalance feeds the subtraction of the burned amount from state.
_burn decreases the _totalSupply state variable.
_approve writes the new allowance into the _allowances mapping.
approve routes its allowance update through the internal _approve.
increaseAllowance routes its allowance update through the internal _approve.
decreaseAllowance routes its allowance update through the internal _approve.
The spender parameter determines whose allowance entry approve overwrites.
The addedValue parameter is summed with the current allowance, an arithmetic accumulation path.
The subtractedValue parameter is subtracted from the current allowance under a require guard.
The account parameter of _mint is the credit destination.
The account parameter of _burn is the debit source.
The SimpleERC20 constructor calls _mint to create the initial supply.
initialBalance_ flows from the constructor parameter into the _mint amount after the non-zero require.
feeReceiver_ is forwarded into the ServicePayer constructor as the payment destination.
ServicePayer constructor performs an external payable call to an arbitrary receiver-supplied contract before any state is finalized, exposing a reentrancy/payment-injection surface.
The external IPayable.pay invocation hands control to an untrusted contract that can re-enter the deployment/call path.
name_ is forwarded to the ERC20 base constructor storing _name.
symbol_ is forwarded to the ERC20 base constructor storing _symbol.
The constructor chain initializes the _name state variable from name_.
The constructor chain initializes the _symbol state variable from symbol_.
